# MemWal contract dependency

Vendored from [MystenLabs/walrus-memory](https://github.com/MystenLabs/walrus-memory/tree/bbf6b2268f1985bbafbb9f2aab16436fc30da7da/services/contract) at commit `bbf6b2268f1985bbafbb9f2aab16436fc30da7da` (Apache-2.0; see LICENSE). The production account module is unchanged. SolvencyLoop adds only `#[test_only]` fixtures. Both dependency manifests pin official mainnet-v1.82.3 framework commit `bf4073918ed33cfa0b09c500658fa116a774bcfd`, matching the primary CLI/VM. The project isolates a 1.72.2 dependency-only verifier because that command interface was removed from newer releases. Live source verification passed on 2026-11-03, including the unchanged deployed MemWal package; direct MemWal root verification with 1.82.3 also passed. The old VM must not be used for current framework tests.

`Published.toml` records the existing original Mainnet package binding reported by the public relayer on 2026-10-30. The manifest uses the current package format, omits legacy address tables, and pins `std` and `sui` to the project's tested framework. This is a dependency on the existing protocol, not a second package to publish. `npm run move:verify-bundle` verifies the offline bundle references it and includes only the two application modules. Keep dependency verification enabled. `npm run move:verify-deps` uses the configured direct Mainnet Sui CLI environment, without signing or an application Tatum key. Review source, published IDs and lockfile together on upgrades.
